title: Portland Party Bike Tours: The Classic Crawl - Public
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore Portland's vibrant nightlife on a two-hour guided bike tour, where laughter and good vibes flow alongside refreshing drinks. The Classic Crawl takes you through the city's coolest neighborhoods and stops at three local bars, showcasing everything from neon-lit dives to quirky favorites. Perfect for groups looking to celebrate special occasions or simply enjoy a fun night out, this tour features onboard music and group photos to capture the memories. Come ready to pedal and dress up for the occasion—costumes are encouraged.

- A public tour means making new friends, allowing others to join you on your crawl.
- Two-hour guided bike tour through Portland's neighborhoods.
- Visit three unique bars and enjoy a lively atmosphere.
- Group photos and music provided for a memorable experience.
- Minimum group size of 6 and maximum of 15 riders.
